name: Yosuke Hanamura
description: The protagonist's clumsy but reliable partner. His bond deepens as you help him deal with his status as the manager's son and his grief over Saki Konishi.

name: Chie Satonaka
description: An energetic girl who loves steak and martial arts. Her bond grows as she struggles with her protective feelings toward Yukiko and what true strength means.

name: Yukiko Amagi
location: Yasogami High Class Building 1F - School Days
description: The elegant heiress to the famous Amagi Inn. Her link focuses on her desire to escape her predetermined future and find her own path in life.

name: Kanji Tatsumi
location: Shopping District (North) - Near the Textile Shop
description: A tough guy with a soft heart who loves knitting. His bond explores his insecurities about his masculine identity and acceptance.
